What's included

  • Full truckload (FTL)

    A dedicated truck for your cargo, direct from pickup to delivery.

  • Part load (LTL)

    Share truck space for smaller shipments and pay for the space you use.

  • Cross-border

    Road transport between Kuwait, the GCC and neighbouring countries, with border formalities handled.

  • Specialised trucks

    Flatbeds, curtain-siders and refrigerated trucks to suit the cargo.

How it works

  1. 01

    Share the details

    Goods, weight, number of pallets, pickup and delivery addresses.

  2. 02

    Quote and booking

    We choose FTL or LTL and the right truck type, and confirm the pickup date.

  3. 03

    Pickup and border crossing

    Loading, export formalities and customs at each border.

  4. 04

    Delivery

    Import clearance at destination and delivery to the receiver.

Documents you'll need

Exact requirements depend on the goods and the countries involved — we confirm the list with your quote.

  • Commercial invoice
  • Packing list
  • CMR consignment note
  • Certificate of origin
  • Transit documents where cargo crosses a third country

Questions

Should I choose FTL or LTL?

FTL suits shipments that fill most of a truck or need to move directly and quickly. LTL is more economical for a few pallets.

Do goods made in the GCC pay customs duty?

Goods of GCC national origin generally move between member states free of customs duty when they have a valid GCC certificate of origin. Other goods are charged under the common customs tariff.

What slows down a border crossing?

Missing or inconsistent documents are the most common cause. We check your invoice, packing list and certificates before the truck leaves.

أسئلة شائعة

هل أختار حمولة كاملة أم جزئية؟

تناسب الحمولة الكاملة الشحنات التي تملأ معظم الشاحنة أو تحتاج نقلاً مباشراً وسريعاً. أما الجزئية فأوفر لعدد قليل من الطبليات.

هل تدفع البضائع الخليجية المنشأ رسوماً جمركية؟

تنتقل البضائع ذات المنشأ الوطني الخليجي بين الدول الأعضاء عموماً معفاة من الرسوم الجمركية عند وجود شهادة منشأ خليجية سارية. أما غيرها فتخضع للتعرفة الجمركية الموحدة.

ما الذي يؤخر عبور الحدود؟

أكثر الأسباب شيوعاً المستندات الناقصة أو غير المتطابقة. نراجع الفاتورة وقائمة التعبئة والشهادات قبل تحرك الشاحنة.
